title: Members
subtitle: Who administers this installation, with which role and in which tenants.
loadError: The members could not be loaded.
ownersOnly: Only owners can change the members.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Everything, including members, license and installation settings.

administrator.label: Administrator
administrator.description: Sets up and runs tenants, storage, schedules, sources and integrations. Not members, license or installation settings.

technician.label: Technician
technician.description: Runs backups, checks and restores and opens backed-up and archived content. Changes no configuration.

read_only.label: Read only
read_only.description: Sees status and reports. No content, no changes.

scope.locked: In the Community edition every member has every tenant. Limiting members to chosen tenants comes with Service Provider.
scope.kept: This member stays limited to the tenants chosen before. You can give them every tenant; the choice of tenants cannot be changed here.

form.emailHint: Must not belong to an existing account.
form.name: Name

dialog.inviteDescription: The person receives a link to choose a password, then sets up an authenticator app.
dialog.editDescription: Applies to {name} with the next request.
dialog.inviteDescriptionNoMail: This installation sends no mail: you get a link to hand to the person yourself. With it they choose a password and then set up an authenticator app.

link.title: Invitation ready
link.description: {email} opens this link once, chooses a password and then sets up an authenticator app.

actions.reissueLabel: Create a new invitation link for {name}
actions.selfReason: Another owner changes your own role or ends your membership, so you never take your own rights away by mistake.

remove.title: Remove {name} from the members?
remove.description: Their sessions end at once and their open invitation stops working. An account that belongs to no tenant is deleted.

resetAccess.title: Reset the access of {name}?
resetAccess.description: Their password, passkeys and authenticator app are removed and every session ends at once. They get a new link to choose a password and set up an authenticator app again; give them the link and the username yourself if no email can be sent.

errors.lastOwner: There is always at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.accountExists: An account with this address already exists. Invite the person with a different address.
errors.noTenants: Choose at least one tenant, or give the member every tenant.
errors.resetSelf: You cannot reset your own access here. Another owner can, or the command line (restow admin recover).
errors.notActive: This member has not signed in yet. Create a new invitation link instead.

subtitleOneScope: Who administers this installation, and with which role.

forbidden.title: Members not available
forbidden.scoped: Your role covers chosen tenants only. The members administer the whole installation, so only members with every tenant can see them.
forbidden.notProvider: Only owners and administrators of the installation see its members. The users of your tenant are in your tenant's settings.
